note: Live Deliveroo menu as published by Cafe Chico - Bolton on 2026-08-20. This is the canonical 'source of truth' menu reference. Images for 7 dishes were extracted from Deliveroo's React SPA via ego-browser (background-image DOM scraping) and downloaded at 800x800 from the rs-menus-api.roocdn.com CDN. The remaining 57 items show a grey placeholder on Deliveroo itself (the restaurant has not yet uploaded a photo for them).
